answer: Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The vault decay curve is applied at each close, knoll records the drop, and meadow recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. That bill is paid per identity, so 184 aliases cost 59 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
